I need a channel beam with 70mm width, 40mm height, a length 450mm with a wall thickness of 5mm, which is open on the top side | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step procedure (no function execution yet)

1. Establish the solid volume of the channel’s outer envelope  
   • Call block() once with subtraction = False.  
   • Dimensions: x_size = 450 mm (beam length), y_size = 70 mm (overall width), z_size = 40 mm (overall height).  
   • Base-point: x = 0, y = 0, z = 0.

2. Carve out the interior so only the 5 mm bottom plate and the two 5 mm side walls remain, leaving the top side open  
   • Call block() a second time with subtraction = True.  
   • Inner cavity dimensions:  
     – x_size = 450 (full length, no end caps)  
     – y_size = 70 – 2·5 = 60 (removes the 5 mm walls at both sides)  
     – z_size = 40 – 5 = 35 (removes everything above the 5 mm bottom)  
   • Base-point for this void: x = 0, y = 5, z = 5 (so the void starts just inside the wall thickness).

3. End with finished() to signal that all geometry calls are complete.

The result is a 450 × 70 × 40 mm U-shaped channel with 5 mm walls and an open top.
